name: Can I rent out a granny flat to tenants in Florida?
description: Rental eligibility depends on your specific city, county, and HOA zoning rules, as some areas restrict secondary suites to family members or caregivers.

mainEntity.name: Can I rent out a granny flat to tenants in Florida?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Florida, local municipal regulations, HOA rules, and county zoning determine whether you can rent out a secondary suite on your property. Some residential zones permit long-term leasing to unrelated tenants, while others restrict secondary dwellings to immediate family members or caregivers. Additionally, short-term vacation rentals are heavily restricted or prohibited in many suburban residential neighborhoods across Hillsborough and Pinellas counties. Always review your local zoning ordinances and deed restrictions before planning a project intended to produce regular rental income.
